# Medcon

> Medcon, operated by Medcon Educational Services and Consultancy Limited, provides structured international medical education admissions guidance for African students and their families.

## Primary topics

- Studying medicine in the Philippines
- International medical school admissions guidance
- Partner medical colleges and programme comparisons
- Eligibility, tuition, intake, and document preparation guidance
- Support for parents and education recruitment agents

## Important pages

- [Home](https://aqqute.com/MedCon/): Overview of Medcon and its admissions support services.
- [About](https://aqqute.com/MedCon/about): Information about Medcon Educational Services and Consultancy Limited.
- [Study Medicine in the Philippines](https://aqqute.com/MedCon/study-medicine-in-philippines): Guidance about the Philippines medical education route.
- [Partner Colleges](https://aqqute.com/MedCon/colleges): Comparison of Medcon partner medical colleges.
- [PLTCI College of Medicine](https://aqqute.com/MedCon/college-pltci-college-of-medicine): Programme and admissions information for PLTCI College of Medicine.
- [The Manila Times College School of Medicine](https://aqqute.com/MedCon/college-the-manila-times-college-school-of-medicine): Programme and admissions information for The Manila Times College School of Medicine.
- [Apply](https://aqqute.com/MedCon/apply): Student admissions enquiry form.
- [Parent Guidance](https://aqqute.com/MedCon/for-parents): Information and consultation requests for families.
- [Agent Partnerships](https://aqqute.com/MedCon/for-agents): Information for education agents and referral partners.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://aqqute.com/MedCon/faqs): Common admissions and study-abroad questions.
- [Contact](https://aqqute.com/MedCon/contact): Official contact channels for Medcon.

## Official contact

- Email: info@medconedu.org
- Phone and WhatsApp: +234 703 696 1056

## Accuracy notice

Tuition, programme availability, intake dates, admission requirements, and institutional processes may change. Visitors should confirm current information directly with Medcon before making financial, academic, travel, or enrolment decisions.
